notes.title: Early Access Build 6 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Release Notes

Minimap
- added the minimap
- select the minimap to quickly travel around the map

Revamped strategy cam
- edge scrolling
- Isometric perspective
- fixed an issue where the mouse wheel changed zoom even when not in the current camera mode

Revamped HUD
- moved most information to bottom of screen
- added the hotkey text for turrets
- added the hotkey text for warships

Graphics
- added underwater effect to the camera

Levels
- implemented level bounds
- shifted starting coordinates on some missions to fit inside minimaps

Options
 - added option for edge scroll speed
 - added option for camera zoom speed

Multiplayer
 - fixed an issue where Prepare Broadside failed to activate for client players
 - improved UI stability for client players
 - flags default to red vs blue instead of historical flags

Bug fixes
 - fixed an issue with the Prepare Broadside ability rotating turrets in an invalid way

Project Stats
Issues resolved this sprint: 24

Issues kicked to next sprint: 6

Issues in the backlog: 92

Total issues resolved: 103

notes.title: Update Announcement - Early Access Build 3
notes.notes:
Headlines

Binocular Mode: Free look around from the crow's nest to gain a vantage on fleet position and enemy movement

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43215752/2c9af6dcb896c6ac19d71ff1b840d2738cbe36f0.gif
Fleet Battle

 New game mode, replacing Quick Battle, featuring additional customization options

Fleet Builder

 Choose from 8 different formations including Wedge, Cross, Slant, and others
 Designate a flagship
 Pick an escort from among any class of warship

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43215752/0a986a986fad8935406123b377e7ca57b78461b3.gif
Scenario Editor

 Two new scenario types:

Deathmatch: Defeat the entire opposing fleet
Flagship: Destroy the enemy flagship

Rogue Mission

 Upcoming: Rogue Mission will be a new "side mission" game mode with strategy, tactics, and rogue-lite elements

Campaign

 Fixed an issue that might occur after beating the campaign

Various Improvements and Bug Fixes

 Added new boat wake visual feature
 New Tips (i.e. Hints) menu
 Compass direction now aligns with cardinal text
 Intro sequence now only plays once per session
 Continue reworking some systems for future multiplayer support

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Early Access Build 2
notes.notes:
*Alas, the sounds of war have upset a mythical beast from the depths!*

New
- Final boss fight in the North Sea campaign (re-clear 3rd mission to unlock)
- New Game + is a more difficult, timed mode
- Begin internal implementation of scenario feature
- Very limited and partial gamepad controller support
- (PC) (Graphics) Additional post-processing effects
- (PC) (Performance) Removed frame rate smoothing and removed the frame rate cap

Fixed
- Fixed an issue where turret rotation speed was affected by FPS
- Fixed a typo that displayed in the flavor text of the first mission
- Fixed an issue where a level unlock could fail to be saved
- Improved aesthetics, size, and layout of multiple menus and HUD
- (PC) Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would sometimes fail to display in the main menu
- (iOS) Fixed issues with menu items being inaccessible on screens with rounded corners

Proceed to the the product page for links to download the game.
